updates.title: First preview - status & roadmap
updates.markdown:
## QuBrain Omni is in preview

This is the first public status entry for the desktop browser. QuBrain Search and the Omni API already run on **Cloudflare Workers** at the edge (`api.qubrain.org`). The app UI is usable day-to-day, but several surfaces are still unfinished — this post is the honest snapshot.

## What the browser can do today

- **Tabs** — open, close, reorder, session restore, reopen closed tabs, per-tab mute, favicons, hover tips (title / domain / memory)
- **Navigation** — back, forward, reload, hard reload, stop, omnibox (URL or search)
- **Start page** — clock, branding, search, engine picker (QuBrain default + Brave, DDG, Google, Bing, …)
- **QuBrain Search** — All / Images / News / Videos SERP, knowledge panel, pagination, image proxy
- **Library** — bookmarks (toolbar + manager), history (manager + menu flyout), downloads (progress ring + manager)
- **Media controls** — toolbar button when a tab plays audio/video; play/pause, seek, ±10s, PiP when available
- **App menu** — New Tab / Window, History, Bookmarks, Downloads, Info, Exit
- **Info → Updates** — this feed, loaded live from Cloudflare KV (not baked into the app binary)

## Feature status

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Window chrome & multi-window | Ready | Min / max / close, new window |
| Tabs & session restore | Ready | Includes closed-tab restore |
| Navigation + omnibox | Ready | URL or search |
| Start page | Preview | Preview banner still shown |
| Search engine picker | Ready | Default: QuBrain |
| QuBrain SERP (All / Images / News / Videos) | Ready | Via `api.qubrain.org` |
| Knowledge / Wikipedia panel | Ready | Side panel on SERP |
| Maps SERP | Experimental | **Off by default** — enable with `omni.features.maps=1` |
| Bookmarks | Ready | Toolbar + manager |
| History | Ready | Manager + flyout |
| Downloads | Ready | CEF downloads + UI |
| Global media controls | Ready | Overlay above content |
| Per-tab mute | Ready | Speaker icon on tab |
| Info / Updates feed | Ready | Cloudflare-backed |
| New Private Window | Planned | Menu item exists, **not implemented** |
| Delete Browsing Data | Planned | Menu item exists, **not implemented** |
| Site permissions (general) | Known issues | Only Maps geolocation chip so far |
| Extensions / sync / passwords | Planned | Not started |
| Find in page / DevTools UI | Planned | Not started |

## Known problems

- **Preview quality** — chrome and start page are still marked as work-in-progress; expect layout and polish changes.
- **Maps** — place search, opening hours, and nearby POIs are incomplete / flaky, so Maps is hidden from the tab bar until it is ready enough.
- **Private browsing** — the menu entry does nothing yet (no isolated profile).
- **Delete browsing data** — no unified clear flow from the menu yet (history / bookmarks / downloads can still be cleared on their own pages).
- **Permissions** — no full site-permission model in the native host; only the Maps location prompt in the SERP.
- **Edge cases** — rapid tab close / reopen used to race the content browser; recycling was added, but keep reporting crashes if you hit them.

## Cloudflare backend (already shipping)

- Search API on Workers with global edge latency
- KV cache for responses and **this updates feed**
- D1 + Vectorize own-index hybrid with SearXNG
- Browser Rendering + Workers AI for previews / enrichment
- Image proxy and place/geocode helpers for Maps

## What we want to improve next

1. **Finish or remove stubs** — Private Window and Delete Browsing Data should either work or leave the menu.
2. **Maps v1** — stabilize place results and hours, then bring the Maps tab back by default.
3. **Permissions** — real prompts for geolocation / notifications / media from pages, not only SERP helpers.
4. **Settings** — engine default, Maps flag, data clearing, and basic privacy toggles in one place.
5. **Stability & polish** — fewer preview banners, tighter tab/media edge cases, clearer empty states.
6. **Later** — find-in-page, password manager hooks, sync, extensions (only after the core browser feels solid).

Thanks for testing the preview — new entries will land here as features ship or known issues close.
